assessment_source: structure-codebase audit 2026-09-19 (conversation) -> issues #1291, #1126 (comment), F3 doc rule

reasons: No ratchet: LEGACY_APPLICATION_IMPORTS was deleted and a guard test in scripts/check-architecture.test.mjs keeps it deleted, so the file|module|symbol triplet format this plan copies does not exist.
No filesystem-derived feature registry: app-generic globs already cover every feature module in every bot; the cross-feature rule was uncovered only because it was written outside the rule table.
Scope is zalo-bot and discord-bot, not all three bots. messenger-bot is deferred because its largest cluster is dependency inversion, not hygiene.
The 58-edge / 40-CONCRETE inventory is not reproducible: its scan script lived in a temp directory, the per-pair counts sum to 39, and the wispace module directory is absent.

verification.boundary: npm run architecture:test && npm run architecture:check
verification.lint: npm run format:check && npm run lint
verification.build: npm run build (post-flight only; required per-chunk if apps/*/src or packages/*/src is touched)

chunks.name: Feature registry refactor inside the checker (behavior-preserving)
